WITH filtered_wijken AS (
    SELECT 
        WijkenEnBuurten,
        SUM(Value) AS totale_huizen_met_zonnepanelen
    FROM 
        "data/nl/odata3/84772NED.parquet"

)

    CONCAT_WS(', ', WijkenEnBuurten, Measure) AS Dimension_Measure,
    SUM(Value) AS "SUM[Measure]",
    SUM(CASE WHEN WijkenEnBuurten = 'WK026300' THEN Value ELSE 0 END) AS "WK026300",

UNPIVOT(Value FOR Measure IN ('M002462'))
WHERE 
    WijkenEnBuurten IN ('WK026300', 'WK057900', 'WK048471')
    AND WijkenEnBuurten IN (SELECT WijkenEnBuurten FROM filtered_wijken)
GROUP BY 
    Dimension_Measure

SELECT 
    Measure, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Regio IN ('AM05') AND Niveau IN ('A041759') AND Studierichting IN ('A010286') AND Leerweg IN ('A025293') AND Geslacht IN ('4000') THEN Value ELSE 0 END) AS "AM05_A041759_A010286_A025293_4000",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Regio IN ('NL01') AND Niveau IN ('T001336') AND Studierichting IN ('T001072') AND Leerweg IN ('A025290') AND Geslacht IN ('T001038') THEN Value ELSE 0 END) AS "NL01_T001336_T001072_A025290_T001038",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN Regio IN ('AM05') AND Niveau IN ('A041759') AND Studierichting IN ('A010286') AND Leerweg IN ('A025293') AND Geslacht IN ('4000') THEN Value ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
          NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Regio IN ('NL01') AND Niveau IN ('T001336') AND Studierichting IN ('T001072') AND Leerweg IN ('A025290') AND Geslacht IN ('T001038') THEN Value ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS "%"

        (Regio IN ('AM05') AND Niveau IN ('A041759') AND Studierichting IN ('A010286') AND Leerweg IN ('A025293') AND Geslacht IN ('4000'))

) 
GROUP BY Measure

Hoeveel procent van de bewoners van Saba.query: SELECT T1.Perioden, T1.Value AS "Procent overlast Saba 2013", T2.Perioden, T2.Value AS "Uitvoerwaarde Bonaire 2012-2013" FROM (SELECT Perioden, Value FROM "data/nl/odata3/82557NED.parquet" UNPIVOT(Value FOR Measure IN ('A047645_2')) WHERE CaribischNederland = 'GM9003' AND Perioden = '2013JJ00' AND Persoonskenmerken = 'T009002' AND Marges = 'MW00000') AS T1 FULL JOIN (SELECT Perioden, Value FROM "data/nl/odata3/82659NED.parquet" UNPIVOT(Value FOR Measure IN ('D001636_1')) WHERE GoederenindelingSITC = 'T001082' AND Perioden IN ('2012JJ00', '2013JJ00')) AS T2 ON T1.Perioden = T2.Perioden

Wat was in 2023 het gemiddelde jaarbedra.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT Measure, Value, Btw FROM "data/nl/odata3/85592NED.parquet" UNPIVOT(Value FOR Measure IN ('M001013_1')) WHERE Perioden IN ('2023JJ00') AND Btw IN ('A048944', 'A048945')) PIVOT(AVG(Value) FOR Measure IN ('M001013_1') GROUP BY Btw)

Wat was de gemiddelde variabele elektric.query: SELECT TableA.Perioden, TableA."SUM[M007924_2]" AS "Gemiddelde variabele elektriciteitsprijs incl. btw (Euro/kWh)", TableB."AVG[M008103]" AS "% studenten Niet te combineren met opleiding NL" FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT Measure, Value, Perioden FROM "data/nl/odata3/85592NED.parquet" UNPIVOT(Value FOR Measure IN ('M007924_2')) WHERE Perioden IN ('2022JJ00', '2023JJ00', '2024JJ00') AND Btw IN ('A048944')) PIVOT(SUM(Value) FOR Measure IN ('M007924_2') GROUP BY Perioden)) AS TableA FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT Measure, Value, Perioden, Onderwijs FROM "data/nl/odata3/85907NED.parquet" UNPIVOT(Value FOR Measure IN ('M008103')) WHERE Perioden IN ('2022JJ00', '2023JJ00', '2024JJ00') AND Onderwijs IN ('A010290')) PIVOT(AVG(Value) FOR Measure IN ('M008103') GROUP BY Perioden)) AS TableB ON TableA.Perioden = TableB.Perioden
